body: Concrete preserved proof prerequisites: TEMP/dm731-proof/proof.cjs open action only writes localStorage dm.selection with a backslash folderPath and reloads; it never exercises the actual Knowledge→Learnings entry. launch.cjs and seed.ts still point at dm-learnings-DM731, so update throwaway paths to the current owned UI worktree. Seed creates a DB-only folder but no Git repository and reports commit 827ab889 from another repository; use an owned real Git scratch project/current local commit for useful source-commit navigation, not invented provenance. Reuse the bootstrap, do not build a harness. For stale lifecycle, use actual competing retire/replace: preserve draft, explicitly refresh/show retired or successor state; do not invent a revision-edit API or fake DB bump to make retry succeed.
